name: Zegana
description: Zegana was the Utopian Speaker of the Simic Combine on Ravnica and Kaszira's aunt, who was found murdered at the Karlov Manor gala.

description_citations.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

summary.text: Zegana was the Utopian Speaker of the Simic Combine on Ravnica and Kaszira's aunt, who was found murdered at the Karlov Manor gala.

bio.text: As Utopian Speaker she banned her niece Kaszira and her friends from the zonots, though Medge pleaded that Kaszira be allowed to study.

citations.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

bio.text: She was on poor terms with Vannifar since Vannifar unseated her predecessor, though the two were rivals who were like sisters.
At the gala she mistook Kellan for the detective Proft.

timeline.summary: Speaker Zegana bans Kaszira and her friends from the zonots, but Medge pleads that Kaszira be allowed to study.
timeline.quote: You and your friends are to return to merfolk territory immediately and are hereby banned from the zonots.

citation.text: "The Principles of Unnatural Selection" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Zegana mistakes Kellan for the detective Proft.
timeline.quote: Are you quite sure you're not that detective Proft everyone's been talking about?

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Teysa and Kaya find Zegana dead, posed on a pile of coats in the cloakroom.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine was artfully arranged at the center of the pile.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya notices a black iris petal in Zegana's fingers, though none was used in the decor.
timeline.quote: Kaya saw the edges of a flower petal protruding from between Zegana's fingers.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Teysa informs Vannifar of Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: it is with the deepest of regrets that I inform you that Zegana of the Simic Combine has been killed.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft deduces that Zegana was posed so the guild seals form a pattern.
timeline.quote: she has been arranged such that the sign of each guild is visible on the coats beneath her, and a pattern has been formed.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 2: Monsters We Became" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Teysa reports Vannifar is moving from grief to outrage over Zegana's death.
timeline.quote: Vannifar won't allow this to go unanswered.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Etrata denies killing Zegana and says she does not remember it.
timeline.quote: If I killed her, I don't remember it.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 3: Shadows of Regret" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Etrata claims Proft and says they are finding out who really killed Zegana; Massacre Girl stands down.
timeline.quote: I'm helping him find out who really killed Zegana.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 5: Chains of Expectation" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft lists the victims and the attempt on Aurelia, noting the killers had no memory.
timeline.quote: Zegana of the Simic Combine; Teysa of the Orzhov Syndicate; Kylox of the Izzet League.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Oba accuses Zegana of experimenting with Phyrexian oil on ordinary creatures.
timeline.quote: Zegana was fascinated by the Phyrexian oil.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Vannifar reveals Zegana was seeking a cure for phyresis with her consent.
timeline.quote: She was seeking a cure for phyresis, the spreading taint of Phyrexia

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft exposes and captures Etrata for Zegana's murder, then helps her escape custody.
timeline.quote: Three days later, believing Etrata was not guilty of the murder but may have information, he helped her escape from Azorius custody.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ravnica Kellan works for the Agency while Amalia researches the plane and a Gruul ruin.
timeline.quote: Amalia researched the plane and its history

citation.text: "Amalia Benavides Aguirre", section "On Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Karlov Manor Zegana is assassinated and Massacre Girl attempts Aurelia's life; Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos win time to investigate.
timeline.quote: an attempt was made on her own life by Massacre Girl

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Crime wave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Zegana is assassinated, Etrata is discovered and captured by Proft with help from Kaya and Kellan.
timeline.quote: she was discovered and captured by Alquist Proft

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, the detective reveals that Oba organized the murders as retribution against traitors of the plane, and that Etrata was Zegana's killer.
timeline.quote: the detective revealed that Oba, the central dryad of Trostani

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana delivers the Fathom Edict announcing the rebirth of the Simic.
timeline.quote: Zegana announced the rebirth of the Simic under new philosophical principles

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fearing he is next after the murders of Zegana and Teysa, Krenko kidnaps Kylox but is thwarted by Proft and Etrata; a brainwashed citizen attacks and accidentally kills Kylox.
timeline.quote: accidentally killing Kylox first

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana is assassinated at Karlov Manor and Lavinia leads the investigation.
timeline.quote: she was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Aftermath of the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Miko accidentally causes a cytoplast to fall on Medge, starting her mutation; the class is imprisoned and then released through Zegana's intervention.
timeline.quote: initiating her mutation

citation.text: "Medge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Judith frames Rakdos for the Karlov Manor murders, imprisoning Agrus Kos who found Rakdos asleep.
timeline.quote: Judith imprisoned Kos, leaving nobody who could advocate for the demon's innocence.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Persecution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Karlov Manor, Zegana is assassinated and Etrata is arrested as a suspect.
timeline.quote: During the celebration, Zegana was assassinated, and Etrata was arrested as a suspect, though she maintained her innocence.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the rediscovery of the oceans through the Zonots, the Simic are remade from scratch, rejecting Vig's philosophy; Zegana becomes guildmaster.
timeline.quote: the Simic were remade from scratch

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Return to Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Golgari incursions threaten Zonot Four, Vannifar replaces Zegana as Prime Speaker and begins the Guardian Project.
timeline.quote: Zegana was replaced as Prime Speaker by Vannifar

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the invasion Zegana tries to regain Prime Speaker and is then brutally murdered; Vannifar seeks other guilds' aid and keeps her position.
timeline.quote: after Zegana was brutally murdered

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa hosts a party at Karlov Manor; Zegana is assassinated and Teysa avoids questioning by the Azorius.
timeline.quote: After Zegana was assassinated at the party, Teysa avoided questioning by the Azorius.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oba brainwashes Etrata into killing Zegana, drawing media attention and the detective Alquist Proft.
timeline.quote: when she brainwashed Etrata into killing Zegana , the case began to attract media attention

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals at Vitu-Ghazi that Oba organized the murders as retribution against those she considered traitors.
timeline.quote: Proft revealed that Trostani — specifically Oba — was responsible for organizing the murders

citation.text: "Trostani", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zegana summons Vannifar to Zonot Seven for a reprimand before the Speakers' Chamber.
timeline.quote: Zegana had to summon Vannifar to Zonot Seven for a reprimand before the Speakers' Chamber.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar makes Zegana's leadership the subject of open debate and is voted the new Prime Speaker.
timeline.quote: A vote was called, and Vannifar was made the new Prime Speaker .

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Prime Speaker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion many Simic become Phyrexianized; Vannifar and Zegana settle their grievances and Zegana researches a cure.
timeline.quote: Vannifar and Zegana settled their old grievances

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vannifar is present at Karlov Manor when Zegana is assassinated and avoids questioning.
timeline.quote: she was present at Karlov Manor when Zegana was assassinated, and avoided questioning when the Azorius began investigating.

citation.text: "Vannifar", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
